PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Plane Geometry, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Plane Geometry.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Plane Geometry.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Plane Geometry.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Plane Geometry.

3. When learning Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .
   C. Skip safety briefings for Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .

4. When learning Plain Scale Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Plain Scale Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Plain Scale Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Plain Scale Drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Plain Scale Drawing.

5. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Overload every socket

6. When learning Cutting Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cutting Tools.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cutting Tools.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Cutting Tools.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cutting Tools.

7. When learning Ceramic Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Ceramic Materials.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ceramic Materials.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ceramic Materials.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ceramic Materials.

8. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Input Cable Tester

9. When learning Data Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data Safety.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Data Safety.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Safety.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data Safety.

10. When learning Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.

11. When learning Dimensioning, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Dimensioning.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Dimensioning.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Dimensioning.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Dimensioning.

12. When learning Computer Software, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Software.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Software.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Software.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Computer Software.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Composite Materials and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
